engine2.dll.verdict: Host Engine Timing, Profiling Subsystems & VProf Lite Controls
engine2.dll.summary: Major refactoring in engine2.dll introducing new VProf Lite profiler controls (vprof_lite_auto, clear=1), refactored string command option parser, and sub-tick packet entity job processing optimizations.

samples.title: VProf Lite Profiler Automation & Option Parsing
samples.old_asm: ; Legacy engine profiling dispatch loop (no dynamic clear flag)
samples.new_asm:
sub     rsp, 48h
call    VProf_ParseOptionBoolean ; check 'clear' token
test    al, al
jz      short loc_exit
cmp     byte ptr [rip+vprof_lite_auto], 0 ; check auto-profiling state
jz      short loc_skip_log
call    LoggingSystem_Log ; 'Setting vprof_lite_auto 0: game will no longer stop on its own'
call    VProfLite_Clear
mov     cl, 1
call    VProfLite_SetEnabled ; activate profiler session
samples.analysis: Valve introduced dynamic runtime configuration for the internal VProf Lite profiler. Passing clear=1 resets captured timing samples while keeping the profiling session active, preventing automated unannounced profiling dumps during production gameplay.

samples.title: Engine Command-Line Boolean Token Validator
samples.old_asm: ; Basic string comparator without structured diagnostic channel logging
samples.new_asm:
mov     [rsp+8], rbx
mov     [rsp+10h], rsi
push    rdi
sub     rsp, 30h
call    strchr ; find '=' separator
test    rax, rax
jz      short loc_no_eq
call    _V_stricmp_fast ; matches '1', 'true', 'on', 'enable'
test    eax, eax
jz      short loc_true
call    LoggingSystem_Log ; ''%s' is not a boolean; use %s=0 or %s=1'
samples.analysis: Implements strict boolean option parsing for engine configuration arguments. Ensures malformed launch flags emit structured warnings to the LOG_VPROF diagnostic channel rather than silently failing.

networksystem.dll.verdict: High-Throughput Bitstream VarInt Encoding & Wire Protocol Framing
networksystem.dll.summary: Refactored network serialization pipeline: optimized ReadVarInt32 loop checking bit limit against 35, refactored SerializeNetMessage wire packet header offset (+0x50c to +0x288), and updated 40-op Huffman tree field path traversal.

samples.title: High-Throughput Leaf VarInt32 Bitstream Decoder
samples.old_asm:
mov     [rsp+10h], rbx
push    rdi
xor     edi, edi
cmp     ebx, 23h ; 35 bits
jz      loc_overflow
samples.new_asm:
xor     r10d, r10d ; accumulator
mov     rax, rcx   ; buffer ptr
mov     r11d, r8d  ; bit offset
nop     dword ptr [rax]
cmp     r11d, 23h  ; check 35-bit limit (5 * 7 bits)
jz      short loc_overflow
mov     ecx, [rax+10h]
samples.analysis: Refactored into a lean, non-stack-allocating leaf routine using r10d/r11d scratch registers. Checks bit accumulator against 35 (5 bytes * 7 bits) to prevent 32-bit integer overflow during Protobuf wire decoding.

push    r15

ai_overview.title: CS2 Update 26772654 (November 19, 2026) — Damage Prediction Scope Guard, Inferno Dynamic Fire & Teammate Lag Comp
ai_overview.executive_summary: Major 4.9 GB engine overhaul introducing CTakeDamageSummaryScopeGuard in client.dll to eliminate mid-spray view-angle damage mispredictions, realigning CLagCompensationManager::StartLagCompensation for mp_teammates_are_enemies, binding dynamic CFireEnvironment constant buffers for de_inferno flame spread, and stripping 10 legacy r_csgo_frost_* cvars. 100% ABI stability with 92/92 canonical signatures verified.
items_added: Damage Prediction Scope Guard: CTakeDamageSummaryScopeGuard & SummaryTakeDamageInfo_t batching rapid view angle adjustments mid-spray to eliminate prediction desync
Teammate Lag Compensation: CLagCompensationManager::StartLagCompensation realigned (+0x1040 RVA shift) to run lag comp under mp_teammates_are_enemies
Inferno Dynamic Fire Pipeline: CFireEnvironment & BindFireConstantBufferCsgo binding real-time fire constant buffers for surface flame propagation and scorch decals
Stripped Frost Shader ConVars: Removed 10 test cvars (r_csgo_frost_dry_time, r_csgo_frost_heat_*, etc.) streamlining client post-processing
Major Tournament Integration: Added PGL Singapore 2026 CS2 Major Championship asset anchors in client.dll
Protobuf Wire Pricing Extension: CMsgVolatileContainerPricesheet wire message serialization in network system
Slack Ladder Physics: Revised slack ladder Z-coordinate interpolation routine in player movement services
100% Signature Invariance: All 92 canonical function signatures verified with 0 broken patterns across 31 recompiled PE binaries
